claim: The paragraph this PR edits (it hyphenates 'left-hand side' on line 698) still states a wrong identity: line 703 reads $U_N(a, b) = \sum_{i = 1}^N \mathbf{1}_{\{U_N(a, b) < N\}}$, which sums the same indicator N times, and line 705 says $\{U_N(a, b) < N\}$ is measurable 'since $U_N(a, b)$ is a stopping time'. $U_N(a, b)$ is the upcrossing count, not a stopping time. What the code proves (`upcrossingsBefore_eq_sum`, `Adapted.measurable_upcrossingsBefore`) is a sum of indicators of $\{\tau_i < N\}$ over the upper crossing times $\tau_i$ (`upperCrossingTime a b f N i`), which are the stopping times.

$$

stopping time." ($	au_n$ is the notation the file's own module doc sets up at lines 73-83.)
